quote: Started using Galaxium a couple days ago and it's already completely changed how I build. Instead of manually placing parts, I just describe what I want and it's instantly there.
I used to waste hours setting up basic scripts. Galaxium takes me from initial idea to working prototype in minutes.
The instance tree generation is incredible. Full ScreenGuis, scripts, and complete folder hierarchies are all perfectly nested. It feels like pair programming with a Roblox Studio expert.
Been solo deving for a year, and Galaxium is the closest thing to having an actual co-developer. My workflow is significantly faster.
Didn't expect an AI tool to genuinely understand Roblox's instance hierarchy this well. Truly useful for real projects, not just a gimmick.
Galaxium turned my weekend project from an idle idea into something fully polished and shipped in two days.
I manage a small dev team, and Galaxium has become our go-to tool. It drastically cuts down our prototyping phase.
I was genuinely surprised by how clean the code is. It generates well-structured Luau, not messy spaghetti scripts.
I went from barely understanding RemoteEvents to launching a complete shop system in a single afternoon.
The standout feature is how it analyzes your existing DataModel before generating anything. It actually understands your current setup.
Galaxium saves an immense amount of time when iterating on UI and backend architecture. An essential plugin for fast iteration in Studio.
